approach.title: Built to connect
approach.body: The largest project I have built was called Ponte, Italian for bridge. It links phone and PC over the local network, a server, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, and drops the duplicates. I work the same way. I keep interface, protocol and infrastructure together, so nothing gets lost between one step and the next.

items.a: I design and build software for clients: native apps for Android and Windows, web platforms and internal tools, including integrations with AI models.
In Brescia, Italy. I work on site or remotely.

items.q: What projects do you take on?
items.a: Paid projects with a clear goal: a website, a platform, an app or an internal tool that needs to reach production.
It depends on the project. The ones I have already shipped are listed under Tools.
Tell me what you need, who it is for and by when. I reply with the questions still open and a proposal.
